subject: maths
question: Somaraj borrowed an amount of Rs.11,550 at an interest rate of 10% per annum, compounded annually. He paid the entire amount in two equal annual instalments. What is the value of each installment?
solution:
**Given data :**

Principal (P) = Rs 11,550

Interest rate (r) = 10% per annum

Compound frequency (n) = 1 time per year

Time (t) = 2 years

Two equal instalments (P1 and P2)

**Concept:**

The principal plus accrued interest after one year minus the first installment equals the second installment after it accrues interest for one year.

**Solution:**

Calculate the compounded amount after 1 year: P × (1 + r/n)^(nt) ⇒ Rs 11,550 × (1 + 10/100)^(1 × 1) ⇒ Rs 12,705

Let each instalment be X.

Substituting this in our equation gives the balance after the first payment: Rs 12,705 - X

This balance will accrue interest over the next year,

⇒ (Rs 12,705 - X) × (1 + 10/100) ⇒ X

⇒ 1.1 × (Rs 12,705 - X) = X

⇒ 1.1X + X = Rs 13,975.5

⇒ 2.1X = Rs 13,975.5

⇒ X = Rs 13,975.5 / 2.1

⇒ X = (1.1 × Rs 12,705) / 2.1 ⇒ X = Rs 6,655

**Therefore, each instalment would be Rs 6655.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__****Formula Used:**

P = (x)/(1+frac{r){100}}+(x)/((1+frac{r){100})²}+....+(x)/((1+frac{r){100})^n}

Where P = Principal, x = equal installments, and r = rate of interest

**Calculation:**

According to the formula,

11550 = (x)/(1+frac{10){100}}+(x)/((1+frac{10){100})²}

⇒ 11550 = (10x/11) + (100x/121)

⇒ 1155 = 21x/121

⇒ x = 6655

**∴ Each installment is Rs. 6655**
